name: Cousin
source:
She is the co-owner of the hotel with her cousin [url=/c100643]Childhood Friend[/url]. Her mother is [url=/c100653]Thrisha[/url] who raised her as a single mother.

She is incredibly shy and has a problem making friends. Her biggest fear is public speaking and holding a conversation with people. She is a very keen surfer and has been from a very young age.
